summary: Charlie Sheen told People he is raising his 14-year-old twins Max and Bob largely on his own because their mother, Brooke Mueller, is dealing with drug addiction. Fox News Digital pairs this with other celebrity fathers who raised or are raising children solo: John Travolta, Liam Neeson, Kevin Federline and Dean Cain. Each profile covers the circumstances of single parenting and the father's own words about it.
one_line: Charlie Sheen says he is a single dad to 14-year-old twins, and the article profiles other celebrity fathers raising children alone.
key_facts: Charlie Sheen says he is raising his 14-year-old twins Max and Bob on his own and spends most of his time 'doing single dad stuff.'
The twins' mother, Brooke Mueller, has struggled with drug addiction for several years and is 'not in the picture too much right now'; her rep declined to comment.
Sheen has three daughters, one with a high school sweetheart and two with ex-wife Denise Richards, who once took in the twins when Sheen and Mueller were deemed incapable of caring for them.
John Travolta and Kelly Preston married in 1991 and had Jett (died at 16 in 2009), Ella (22) and Benjamin (13); Preston died in 2020 of breast cancer.
On Kevin Hart's 'Hart to Heart' in 2021, Travolta recounted telling his son Ben that nobody knows when they will go, and that Preston died at 57.
Liam Neeson was married to Natasha Richardson from 1994 until her 2009 death after a skiing accident; their sons Micheál and Daniel were 13 and 12 when she died.
Neeson admitted to 'drinking too much' after his wife's death and stopped drinking altogether in 2013.
Micheál, now 28, took his mother's surname Richardson, which Neeson called 'the right thing' and a 'lovely homage.'
Kevin Federline and Britney Spears married in 2004, had sons Preston and Jayden, and divorced in 2007; Federline later got sole physical custody, then sole legal custody in 2008.
Federline's sons moved to Hawaii earlier this year with Spears' approval, and in 2022 they did an ITV interview in which Jayden said the relationship with their mother could be fixed.
Dean Cain and ex-girlfriend Samantha Torres agreed to split custody of son Christopher in 2003 after an 18-month court battle; Cain received sole custody in 2011.
Cain said he turned down what would have been one of the highest-paid TV acting jobs, for a show that ran six years, to be a father during a custody dispute.
